ayahs.tj: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ١
ayahs.en: I swear by the Day of Resurrection

ayahs.tj: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ ٢
ayahs.en: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].

ayahs.tj: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ ٣
ayahs.en: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?

ayahs.ar: بَلىٰ قٰدِرينَ عَلىٰ أَن نُسَوِّىَ بَنانَهُ
ayahs.tj: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ ٤
ayahs.en: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.

ayahs.tj: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ ٥
ayahs.en: But man desires to continue in sin.

ayahs.tj: يَسْــَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ٦
ayahs.en: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

ayahs.tj: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ ٧
ayahs.en: So when vision is dazzled

ayahs.tj: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ ٨
ayahs.en: And the moon darkens

ayahs.tj: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ ٩
ayahs.en: And the sun and the moon are joined,

ayahs.tj: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ ١٠
ayahs.en: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"

ayahs.tj: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ ١١
ayahs.en: No! There is no refuge.

ayahs.tj: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ ١٢
ayahs.en: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.

ayahs.ar: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ الإِنسٰنُ يَومَئِذٍ بِما قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.tj: يُنَبَّؤُاْ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذِۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ ١٣
ayahs.en: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.

ayahs.tj: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ ١٤
ayahs.en: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,

ayahs.tj: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ ١٥
ayahs.en: Even if he presents his excuses.

ayahs.ar: لا تُحَرِّك بِهِ لِسانَكَ لِتَعجَلَ بِهِ
ayahs.tj: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ ١٦
ayahs.en: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.

ayahs.tj: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ ١٧
ayahs.en: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.

ayahs.tj: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ ١٨
ayahs.en: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.

ayahs.tj: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ ١٩
ayahs.en: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].

ayahs.tj: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ ٢٠
ayahs.en: No! But you love the immediate

ayahs.tj: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْأَخِرَةَ ٢١
ayahs.en: And leave the Hereafter.

ayahs.tj: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ ٢٢
ayahs.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,

ayahs.tj: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ ٢٣
ayahs.en: Looking at their Lord.

ayahs.tj: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذِۭ بَاسِرَةٌ ٢٤
ayahs.en: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,

ayahs.tj: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ ٢٥
ayahs.en: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.

ayahs.tj: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ ٢٦
ayahs.en: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones

ayahs.tj: وَقِيلَ مَنْۜ رَاقٍ ٢٧
ayahs.en: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"

ayahs.tj: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ ٢٨
ayahs.en: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation

ayahs.tj: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ ٢٩
ayahs.en: And the leg is wound about the leg,

ayahs.tj: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ ٣٠
ayahs.en: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.

ayahs.tj: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ ٣١
ayahs.en: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.

ayahs.tj: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ٣٢
ayahs.en: But [instead], he denied and turned away.

ayahs.tj: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ ٣٣
ayahs.en: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].

ayahs.tj: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ ٣٤
ayahs.en: Woe to you, and woe!

ayahs.tj: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ ٣٥
ayahs.en: Then woe to you, and woe!

ayahs.tj: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى ٣٦
ayahs.en: Does man think that he will be left neglected?

ayahs.ar: أَلَم يَكُ نُطفَةً مِن مَنِىٍّ يُمنىٰ
ayahs.tj: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ ٣٧
ayahs.en: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?

ayahs.tj: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ ٣٨
ayahs.en: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]

ayahs.tj: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ ٣٩
ayahs.en: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.

ayahs.ar: أَلَيسَ ذٰلِكَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلىٰ أَن يُحـِۧىَ المَوتىٰ
ayahs.tj: أَلَيْسَ ذَٲلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْــِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ٤٠
ayahs.en: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
